detailed_descriptions.en: Annihilation Instinct is included in the Atomic Pass, Gold and Ultimate Edition. Requires the base game Atomic Heart to run. Continue the story in Atomic Heart’s Annihilation Instinct DLC and embark on a journey through the new mind-bending Mendeleev Complex to discover the truth about NORA as P-3 is pulled back into Facility 3826. Survive vicious, shape-shifting new enemies in the Mendeleev Complex and its diverse area and take them down with two new cunning weapons and a new astounding Technostasis ability for your glove. • Visit the Mendeleev Complex and its surrounding swamps, a new area of Atomic Heart’s twisted, dystopian world • Fight against new shape-shifting types of machines and a brand-new boss • Unlock two new weapons: the Secateur - a ranged weapon with 2 firing modes - and the Klusha - a melee weapon that can slash and pierce • Enhance your polymeric glove with the new Technostasis ability, allowing you to manipulate time itself!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Annihilation Instinct is included in the Atomic Pass, Gold and Ultimate Edition.

Requires the base game Atomic Heart to run.

Continue the story in Atomic Heart’s Annihilation Instinct DLC and embark on a journey through the new mind-bending Mendeleev Complex to discover the truth about NORA as P-3 is pulled back into Facility 3826. Survive vicious, shape-shifting new enemies in the Mendeleev Complex and its diverse area and take them down with two new cunning weapons and a new astounding Technostasis ability for your glove.

• Visit the Mendeleev Complex and its surrounding swamps, a new area of Atomic Heart’s twisted, dystopian world

• Fight against new shape-shifting types of machines and a brand-new boss

• Unlock two new weapons: the Secateur - a ranged weapon with 2 firing modes - and the Klusha - a melee weapon that can slash and pierce

• Enhance your polymeric glove with the new Technostasis ability, allowing you to manipulate time itself!
